why: Deviation from the handoff's ratio-of-means at rho=0.01 (fp16). (1) In the fp16 sampler, rounding chaos sets a floor on ||dx0||^2 (at rho=1e-4 the apparent gain2 is 10^1-10^3), so lowering rho as instructed is impossible in fp16; the probe was rerun with an fp32 forward. (2) Even in fp32 the ratio of means is not rho-independent: 1-2 of 16 seeds sit near a trajectory bifurcation, their linear gain keeps growing as rho shrinks, and they dominate the mean. The median over seeds of the per-seed ratio is rho-independent in fp32 (1e-3 vs 3e-3: see table) and is used for Stage 2. Ratio-of-means remains a Stage 3 ablation.
